Name: (SHOP) Food Gal
Author: VoidWitchCult
Description:
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/zD09S1Rm/title2-1-mod-details.png[/img]
﻿
After [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16442]The Sushi Project[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16521]Genshin Valley[/url]﻿ I bring you the next hot seller on the arrowhead island in the cindersap forest! A nice gal backpacking through the valley settled down to sell you her food and recipes that she brought with her from her trip.

36 items, 32 of them recipes you can buy from her. [b]To get to the shop, click the box in the lower right corner of the blanket![/b]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/L65Gx0zJ/title2-1-installation.png[/img]
﻿
 - Install the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher.
- Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
- Run the game using SMAPI.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/FzBk4Tg2/title2-1-campatibility.png[/img]
Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13497]SVR3[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE [/url]!
